stage: FINAL small-angle relic-abundance analysis (theta post-processing of the relic run; no new physics)

inputs.note: resolved at run time by scripts/05_theta/common.jl from WORK/relic/run_config.json (relic tables, A1 table, relic-input manifest) and the repository (relic script, g* table)

dark_matter.TIGHT_DM_rule: 0.9 <= R <= 1.0 (closed; thesis definition, not from the Fuzzy paper)

theta.theta_ref_meaning: normalisation point of the production abundances only; never a physical, preferred or allowed angle
theta.theta_max_meaning: OUR conservative harmonic-analysis restriction (methodological choice; anharmonic deviation ~2-3% at 0.5)
theta.theta_min_meaning: NO lower cutoff. The legacy 1e-5 was an inherited plotting range (theta_lower_domain_audit) and is removed
theta.scaling: Omega_g(theta) = Omega_g(theta_ref) (theta/theta_ref)^2 (exact within the approved harmonic treatment)
theta.common_angle: one theta for every mode of every geometry at a given analysis point
theta.display_range_note: figures may start the axis near 1e-9 for readability; this is a plotting choice, not a cutoff
theta.not_applied: no isocurvature, inflationary-fluctuation or H_I-dependent cut (deferred to future work)

optimisation.N_TIGHT: exact count of closed intervals [theta_90,g, theta_100,g] intersected with (0, 0.5]; sweep over endpoints
optimisation.representative_theta: geometric midpoint of the widest (in log) maximising interval; used only to report class counts
optimisation.upper_boundary_rule: BOUNDARY_LIMITED if the maximising set touches 0.5, or if N_TIGHT rises into 0.5 (positive slope on [0.25,0.5] and larger mean there than on [0.125,0.25]) while the diagnostic continuation of the harmonic formula to pi has a larger maximum above 0.5 (rule unchanged from the approved theta analysis)
optimisation.robust_preferred_angle_rule: methodological choice made here: an INTERIOR maximum is called a robust preferred angle only if (a) the location of the maximum of the smoothed count moves by <= 0.3 dex across smoothing half-widths 0.05/0.1/0.2 dex, (b) the bootstrap 16-84% range of the exact-maximum location is <= 0.5 dex, and (c) the region where the 0.1-dex smoothed count is >= 80% of its maximum is <= 1 dex wide; otherwise it is reported as a broad scale/plateau with its range
